mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_verifications (user_id, email, auth_code, expired_at, verified) VALUES (#{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{email}, #{authCode}, #{expiredAt}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE email_verifications SET verified = 1 WHERE verification_id = #{verificationId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM email_verifications WHERE email = #{email} AND verified = 1
